content.text:
cd /workspace && git commit -m "refactor: enforce supabase-only architecture with clean isolation
Key changes:
1. /events -> 410 Gone (removed redirect)
2. Created services/sources.cjs as single canonical source registry
3. /supabase-events: adds source_counts, explicit freshness
4. /health: adds newest_event, newest_updated timestamps
5. /debug-direct-events: isolated debug endpoint
6. Frontend: uses fetchEvents (Supabase-only, no fallback)
7. All source normalization uses shared sources.cjs module
Verification:
- /health shows: events_last_24h, newest_event, active_sources_count
- /supabase-events shows: source_counts per source
- /events returns: 410 Gone
- Dropdown: only shows sources with actual events in Supabase"
[main d75eb169] refactor: enforce supabase-only architecture with clean isolation
 3 files changed, 315 insertions(+), 414 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 services/sources.cjs
